subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to rewrite the whole story. Only
stimulus: the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1×8= 8 (a) He fell fast asleep there, but a great noise woke him up. (b) It was crying for pain in its leg. (c) Androcles was very much afraid, and he felt sure that the beast would kill him. (d) A lion had entered the cave roaring loudly. (e) He went to the lion. (f) Then he removed a thorn from the lion's paw. (g) Soon he realized that the lion was not angry. (h) Once Androcles fled away from his master's house and hid himself in a forest.
guide_solution: The parts of the story can appear in the following order: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 h a d c g b e f
